name: National fund releases named to BARMM local governments
note: Releases DBM's SARO and NCA listings name as going to one BARMM province, city or municipality, in pesos. A SARO is an allotment (authority to obligate) and an NCA is cash (authority to pay): a release is not spending, and a SARO and its NCA are the same money, so never add the two kinds. Only releases issued to the Bureau of the Treasury or DBM whose purpose writes the LGU's name are here; a negative amount is a withdrawal. This is NOT the LGUs' full Local Government Support Fund take: nearly every LGSF release (Financial Assistance to LGUs, SGLG Incentive Fund, Growth Equity Fund, Support to Barangay Development Program) is listed as "for the recipient LGU per attached Schedule A", and DBM does not publish Schedule A. The per-LGU LGSF releases are only in DBM's Power BI dashboard, which offers no export and could not be read. Releases to the Bangsamoro Government itself (Allocations to LGUs — BARMM) are regional, not local, and are left out, as is money national agencies spend in a place (a DPWH district office, a DepEd division, a hospital in Marawi). The NTA is in nta.json. Sulu is left out; pre-split Maguindanao is under "former". A release that names several LGUs for one amount is under "shared", not split. "fund" is what the purpose says it is chargeable against, null where it says nothing; "barangay" is set where the purpose names one. DBM's FY 2023 NCA listing is a scan: its records were read by OCR, are flagged "ocr", and were checked by eye against the page. Listings that could not be read are named in "missing".
